newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: RODAMCO REPEATS SEES HIGHER 1997/98 NET.
newsitem.headline: RODAMCO REPEATS SEES HIGHER 1997/98 NET.

text.p: Property investment firm Rodamco NV said on Wednesday it stuck to its previous forecasts that net profits per share would show a further rise in the financial year to February 28, 1998.

"The management board expects a further rise of net profits per share to at least 3.40 guilders," Rodamco said in its 1996/97 annual report. It posted a 1996/97 net profit of 460 million guilders or 2.89 guilders per share.
The company said it expected higher rental income in the current financial year and a rising value of its property portfolio.
By the end of 1996/97, Rodamco's investments had a total value of 9.59 billion guilders, up from 7.37 billion one year earlier.
About 68 percent of the portfolio consisted of shops and malls, up from 60 percent in 1995/96. Investments in office buildings fell to 21 percent from 25 percent.
Rodamco has invested 44 percent of its assets in North America and an equal part in Europe. The remaining 12 percent is invested in the Pacific region.
